scope: source-backed traditional guidance; not a verified daily Gregorian converter

records.name: Whiro
records.traditional_claim: Unfavourable for planting and general fishing; good for taking eels in Te Papa compilation.
records.modern_application: Review garden and fishing plans; assess local conditions.
records.notes: Not universally shared across iwi; no automatic Gregorian match.

records.name: Tirea
records.traditional_claim: Reasonably good for crayfishing, eeling, planting, and shellfish collecting.
records.modern_application: Consider planting and shore gathering where conditions and regulations permit.

records.name: Early waxing lunar night
records.traditional_claim: Good for tuber beds, planting and fishing.
records.modern_application: Prepare or plant tuber beds if local agronomic conditions suit.

records.name: Rākaunui
records.traditional_claim: Crops bountiful and fishing favourable, but not eeling.
records.modern_application: Compare fishing conditions and crop readiness.

records.name: Recovery night
records.traditional_claim: Unfavourable day; allow resources to recover.
records.modern_application: Consider leaving a harvesting or fishing area undisturbed.

records.name: Late waning night
records.traditional_claim: Very productive for planting, fishing and eeling in the cited compilation.
records.modern_application: Check locally suitable planting or fishing opportunities.

records.name: Hilo
records.traditional_claim: Planting favourable, though tubers may remain small.
records.modern_application: Consider sowing appropriate crops; note tuber caveat.

records.name: Hoaka
records.traditional_claim: Good day for planting.
records.modern_application: Plan planting according to rainfall and soil moisture.

records.name: Kūkahi
records.traditional_claim: Kū nights recommended for sweet potato, taro and banana in Handy and Handy.
records.modern_application: Consider banana or root-crop planting, subject to local conditions.
records.notes: Historical ritual restrictions could override activity guidance.

records.name: Kūkolu
records.traditional_claim: Kepelino cautions against planting bananas, gourds and sweet potatoes; good for fishing.
records.modern_application: Compare alternatives to planting these crops; check fishing conditions.
records.notes: Tradition-specific exception to general Kū-night rule.

records.name: ʻOlekūkahi
records.traditional_claim: Unfavourable for planting in cited sources.
records.modern_application: Use the day for observation and maintenance rather than planting.

records.name: ʻOlepau
records.traditional_claim: Cited as a productive day as the ʻOle period ends.
records.modern_application: Reassess conditions for field work.

records.name: ʻOlekulua
records.traditional_claim: Kepelino describes a good planting day; Handy and Handy give a conflicting unfavourable assessment.
records.modern_application: Show both interpretations; avoid a definitive recommendation.
records.notes: Conflicting primary-source traditions; must display disagreement.

records.name: Kaloakūkahi
records.traditional_claim: Planting possible but some crops may produce stems rather than fruit quickly.
records.modern_application: Consider crop-specific cautions.

records.name: Akwasidae
records.traditional_claim: Ancestral and royal-stool observance, recurring every six weeks.
records.modern_application: Speak with elders or preserve family histories (modern reflection).
records.notes: Date appears in Akan dictionary; independent guide describes it as calculated, not officially announced. Verify with Manhyia Palace before presenting as official.

records.culture: Ancient Athenian Greek / modern Hellenic reconstruction
records.name: Noumenia
records.traditional_claim: Household deities honoured at start of lunar month.
records.modern_application: Reflect on household wellbeing or start-of-month goals.
records.notes: Modern reconstruction page, not itself an ancient primary source; crescent sighting is not astronomical conjunction.

records.culture: Ancient Athenian Greek / modern Hellenic reconstruction
records.name: Agathos Daimon
records.traditional_claim: Good Spirit household observance following Noumenia.
records.modern_application: Reflect on care and stewardship of home.

records.culture: Ancient Athenian Greek / modern Hellenic reconstruction
records.name: Artemis day
records.traditional_claim: Sixth day associated with Artemis in a modern reconstruction.
records.modern_application: Read historical context; no generic activity recommendation established.

records.culture: Ancient Athenian Greek / modern Hellenic reconstruction
records.name: Apollo day
records.traditional_claim: Seventh day associated with Apollo in a modern reconstruction.
records.modern_application: Read historical context; no generic activity recommendation established.

records.name: Eke
records.traditional_claim: Eke is one of four traditional market-day names; annual agricultural activities were organized through ritual and seasonal markers.
records.modern_application: Check local market scheduling and community observances; no universal Gregorian alignment.
records.notes: Order and alignment vary by community; study describes Nkwerre.
